column1: 30851§successor§səkˈsesə(r)§n. 继任者；接班人；后继者；后人§Few of the personages of past times (except such as have gained renown in fireside legends as well as in written history) are anything but mere names to their successors.§过去时代的众多人物（除了那些在民间传说与书面历史中同样享有盛名者）对**后人**而言，大多只是空洞的名字。§§§§§与 heir（血亲继承人）不同，successor 更强调职位、事业或时代的接续§

30852§feat§fiːt§n. 功绩；壮举；技艺；特技§As one of aviation’s earliest female stunt performers, Gladys Ingle developed a versatile repertoire of acrobatic feats.§作为航空界最早的女性**特技**表演者之一，格拉迪斯·英格尔练就了一套多样的空中特技。§He achieved many incredible martial arts feats—some confirmed and some rumored.§他创下许多惊人的武术**功绩**——有些确有其事，有些只是传闻。§§acrobatic feats 特技动作§与 achievement 近义，但 feat 更强调动作的惊险、技巧性§改例句2：句末多了一个句号

30853§expedition§ˌekspəˈdɪʃn§n. 远征；探险；考察；考察队；（短途）出行§For example, people will always remember that Enid Gordon-Gallien led the expedition that first mapped the area around Kalambo Falls between Zambia and Tanzania.§例如，人们会永远记得，是伊妮德·戈登-加利恩率领**考察队**首次绘制了赞比亚与坦桑尼亚之间卡兰博瀑布周边地区的地图。§NASA mission Expedition 14 took place from September 18, 2006, to April 21, 2007.§美国国家航空航天局第 14 **远征队**任务的时间为 2006 年 9 月 18 日至 2007 年 4 月 21 日。§§lead an expedition 率领考察队§§

30854§speculation§ˌspekjuˈleɪʃn§n. 推测；猜测；思辨；投机§At its core, the movement is characterized by speculation, not just about distant futures or other planets but also about alternate versions of our shared past.§这场运动的核心特征便是**思辨**——不仅思辨遥远的未来与别的星球，也思辨我们共同过去的其他版本。§Well-realized and coherent alternative-history stories can thus complement historians’ speculations about the past.§写得丰满而连贯的架空历史小说，由此能够补充历史学家对过去的种种**推测**。§§speculation in property 房地产投机§§

30855§crude§kruːd§adj. 粗糙的；粗俗的；粗略的；未加工的；天然的§In economics, sugar is considered a soft commodity, while copper and crude oil are considered hard commodities.§在经济学中，糖被视为软性商品，而铜和**原油**被视为硬性商品。§Historian Vicki Valosik claims, “In providing instructions for these aquatic ‘refinements,’ Digby hoped to revive swimming—a once revered skill that had all but died out during Europe’s Dark Ages—and elevate it from a crude, mechanical function of the hands and feet to an artful science.”§历史学家 Vicki Valosik 声称：「通过为这些水上『精进之术』提供指导，迪格比希望复兴游泳——这项一度备受尊崇、却几乎绝迹于欧洲黑暗年代的技艺——并把它从手脚的**粗笨**机械功能提升为一门精妙科学。」§§crude oil 原油；crude comedies 粗俗喜剧§§改译文：原译是另一句的（粗俗喜剧和恶作剧），按英文重译

30856§stark§stɑːk§adj. 鲜明的；明显的；荒凉的；赤裸的；朴素无饰的§The prints in Images of Autonomous Matter, part of a traveling exhibition of innovative Japanese art from the 1960s and 1970s, exemplify the interest in creating minimalist images of stark materials, such as steel, that first emerged among Japanese printmakers in the mid-to-late twentieth century.§《自主物质的影像》（Images of Autonomous Matter）中的版画——出自一个巡展、展出 20 世纪六七十年代日本先锋艺术——体现了对以**冷硬**材料（如钢）营造极简图像的兴趣；这种兴趣于 20 世纪中后期最早出现在日本版画家中。§§§§stark contrasts 鲜明对比；a stark landscape 荒凉的景色§§

30857§sheer§ʃɪə(r)§adj. 纯粹的；十足的；完全的；陡峭的；极薄的§Lin-Manuel Miranda’s 2015 hip-hop musical Hamilton depicts historical political figure Alexander Hamilton as a self-made man who, through sheer determination, transcends his humble origins to become a key participant in the founding of the United States.§林-曼努尔·米兰达 2015 年的嘻哈音乐剧《汉密尔顿》把历史政治人物亚历山大·汉密尔顿塑造成白手起家者——他**仅凭**决心便超越卑微出身，成为美国建国的重要参与者。§Williams and the television miniseries Sheer Perfection, persisted on the site for many years before they were finally recognized as falsehoods and deleted.§……Williams 以及电视迷你剧《**十足**完美》（Sheer Perfection）的词条在网站上存续多年，才最终被识破为虚构并删除。§§through sheer determination 仅凭决心；sheer cliffs 陡峭的悬崖§§改译文2：剧名只留了英文，补出中文以对应 sheer

30858§accommodate§əˈkɒmədeɪt§v. 容纳；适应；为……提供空间；迁就；通融§Still, it can be difficult for companies to offer customization while keeping costs low, as the standard methods of mass production may not be able to accommodate making a unique product each time.§不过，企业要在压低成本的同时提供定制并不容易，因为大规模生产的标准方法未必能**适应**每次生产一件独一无二的产品。§§§§accommodate a request 通融一项请求§§
30859§ideology§ˌaɪdiˈɒlədʒi§n. 意识形态；思想体系§Capital and Ideology has different aims than Piketty's earlier books.§《资本与**意识形态**》与皮凯蒂此前的著作旨趣不同。§§§ideological 意识形态的；ideologue 意识形态鼓吹者§§§

30860§sentiment§ˈsentɪmənt§n. 情绪；情感；感想；（群体的）意见；观点§As with many Highwaymen paintings, the appeal of Yellow Day derived from its ability to capture this sentiment.§与许多「公路人」画派的画作一样，《黄日》的感染力来自它捕捉这种**情绪**的能力。§§§§public sentiment 公众意见§§

30861§supplement§ˈsʌplɪment§v. 补充；增补 n. 补充物；增刊；补充剂§Having found that object emojis generally have a negative effect when used in social media marketing, Anika Desai and team studied reactions to three versions of a bakery’s message about tea: one with a teacup emoji after the text (supplement), one with the emoji standing in for the word “tea” (substitute), and one with no emoji (control).§在发现物体类表情符号用于社交媒体营销通常产生负面效果之后，Anika Desai 及其团队研究了人们对一家面包店茶饮信息的三种版本的反应：一种在文字后加茶杯表情（**补充**型），一种用表情代替「tea」一词（替代型），还有一种不加表情（对照组）。§It had twelve months divided into three weeks of ten days each, followed by five supplemental days.§它把十二个月分为每月三个十日周，其后另加五个**补充**日。§§nutritional supplement 营养补充剂；supplemental adj. 补充的§作名词读 ˈsʌplɪmənt§改译文：漏译后两种版本（替代型、对照组）；改例句2：tree 应为 three，句末多了一个句号
30862§verdict§ˈvɜːdɪkt§n. 裁决；裁定；判断；评价§… resigned or not to the verdict of the public …§无论是否甘于接受公众的**评判**。§§§§reach a verdict 作出裁决；the verdict of the public 公众的评判§§

30863§peninsula§pəˈnɪnsjələ§n. 半岛§A team of scientists led by Artin Arshamian evaluated this view by testing how people from ten different places—including the Semelai people from a small community in the Malay Peninsula and the Chachi people from a small community in Ecuador—ranked ten odors from most pleasant to least pleasant.§由 Artin Arshamian 带领的科学家团队评估了这一观点，方法是测试来自十个不同地方的人——包括来自马来**半岛**一个小社群的塞迈人和来自厄瓜多尔一个小社群的查奇人——如何把十种气味从最宜人到最不宜人排序。§A team led by Octavio Aburto-Oropeza surveyed the biomass density and species composition of two isolated reefs: Alacranes, a protected (fishing prohibited) reef 135 kilometers from the Yucatan Peninsula, and Bajos del Norte, an unprotected reef 25 kilometers further out to sea.§由 Octavio Aburto-Oropeza 领队的团队考察了两处孤立珊瑚礁的生物量密度与物种构成：一是距尤卡坦**半岛** 135 公里、禁止捕鱼的保护区阿尔克兰斯礁，二是再往外海 25 公里、不受保护的巴霍斯德尔诺特礁。§insular 岛屿的；peninsular 半岛的§§§改译文：漏译「把十种气味从最宜人到最不宜人排序」

30864§threshold§ˈθreʃhəʊld§n. 门槛；门口；开端；临界值；阈值§Never, however, was I so aware of entering a new stage as I was that afternoon in October when I finally dared to cross the threshold and my steps sounded hollowly in the unfurnished apartment.§然而，我从未像那年十月的那天下午那样清晰地意识到自己正踏入一个新阶段——我终于敢跨过那道**门槛**，脚步声在空荡的公寓里发出空洞的回响。§Traveling waves break when wave steepness (height-to-length ratio) passes a critical threshold; breaking thus constrains wave height.§行进波在陡度（高长比）超过临界**阈值**时破碎；因此破碎限制了波高。§§cross the threshold 跨过门槛；a required threshold 规定的最低标准§§

30865§passive§ˈpæsɪv§adj. 被动的；消极的；顺从的§When Thornton’s partners, Hans and Pete, arrived on the long-expected raft, Buck refused to notice them till he learned they were close to Thornton; after that he tolerated them in a passive sort of way, accepting favors from them as though he favored them by accepting.§当桑顿的伙伴汉斯和皮特乘着期盼已久的木筏到达时，巴克起初不肯理会他们，直到得知他们与桑顿亲近；此后才以一种**被动**的方式容忍他们，接受他们的好意时，倒像是他肯接受就是给了他们面子。§Their findings revealed that the majority of the turtles passively drifted with ocean currents throughout the region.§他们的发现显示：多数海龟在该海域全程随洋流**被动**漂流。§§passive voice 被动语态；passively adv. 被动地§与 active 相对§改译文：as though he favored them by accepting 是「他肯接受倒像是赏脸」，原译「仿佛那是施舍」意思反了

30866§static§ˈstætɪk§adj. 静止的；静态的；停滞的 n. 静电干扰§Friction, the force that resists the movement of two materials in contact with each other, exists even when the materials are static (not moving).§摩擦力是阻止两个接触物体相对运动的力，即使物体处于**静止**状态时也存在。§§§§a static economy 停滞的经济§§

30867§stance§steɪns§n. 立场；态度；站姿；姿态§Thus, Enke et al. suggest that although the behavior of high-income earners who advocate for higher taxes may seem counterintuitive, such people likely do so because they feel enabled by their economic security to take a stance they think is morally correct.§因此，Enke 等人提出，尽管主张提高税收的高收入者的行为看似违反直觉，但这类人之所以如此，很可能是觉得自己的经济保障让他们有底气采取自认为道德上正确的**立场**。§An ancient statue from the Huasteca region of Mexico represents a subject not seen before in artifacts from the area: a woman in an assertive stance wearing items used in a ceremonial ballgame.§墨西哥瓦斯特卡地区的一尊古代雕像表现了该地区文物中前所未见的题材：一位**姿态**果敢、身着仪式性球赛用具的女子。§§take a stance 表明立场；a relaxed stance 放松的站姿§§改译文：漏译前半句（Enke 等人认为高收入者主张加税看似违反直觉）；补译文2

30868§medieval§ˌmediˈiːvl§adj. 中世纪的（约公元 5 至 15 世纪）§Lestek appears in the Gesta principum Polonorum, a chronicle of medieval Polish history written between 1112 and 1118.§Lestek 见载于《波兰诸王公编年史》（Gesta principum Polonorum）——一部写于 1112 至 1118 年间的**中世纪**波兰史编年史。§Dating to around 1500, the Unicorn Tapestries are seven large tapestries depicting a unicorn hunt that hang in The Cloisters, a museum of medieval art in New York City.§《独角兽挂毯》织于约 1500 年，共七幅巨作，描绘一场独角兽狩猎，悬挂于纽约的**中世纪**艺术博物馆「修道院分馆」。§§§也拼作 mediaeval；与 middle-aged（中年的）无关§改例句：Polishhistory 漏了空格

30869§thesis§ˈθiːsɪs§n. 论点；论题；命题；学位论文§Even when sections do not explicitly support the central thesis, they link to each other in intriguing ways.§即便某些段落并未明确支持中心**论点**，它们之间仍以耐人寻味的方式相互关联。§§§§the central thesis 中心论点；a doctoral thesis 博士论文§§改译文：漏译 in intriguing ways（耐人寻味地）

30870§expertise§ˌekspɜːˈtiːz§n. 专业知识；专门技能；专长§By contrast, doing philosophy within or beyond the academy demands the creative, self-directed application of acquired expertise to enduring questions about the nature of existence and knowledge.§相比之下，在学院之内或之外从事哲学，都要求把习得的**专业知识**创造性地、自主地运用于关于存在与知识之本质的恒久问题。§Studies have shown that consumers view exact prices as reflecting merchant expertise and careful calculation, so why aren’t they more common?§研究表明，消费者把精确价格视为商家**专业**与审慎计算的体现，那为何此类定价并不更常见？§§§与 skill 相比更强调系统化、领域性的知识；与 expert 同源§

30871§elaborate§ɪˈlæbərət§adj. 精巧的；复杂的；详尽的；精心制作的 v. 详细阐述§Pomo artist Susan Billy creates elaborate baskets.§波莫族艺术家苏珊·比利制作**精巧繁复**的篮子。§It contained elaborate multistory buildings primarily made of adobe and stone.§它拥有以土坯和石材为主的多层**精巧**建筑。§§elaborate on 详细阐述§作动词读 ɪˈlæbəreɪt§改例句2：句末多了一个句号

30872§realm§relm§n. 领域；范围；界域；王国；国度§Although Grant Tavinor concludes that computer games are art by virtue of their forming a subcategory of fiction, and Berys Gaut similarly places them within the realm of cinema, neither approach adequately captures a central aspect of playing these games: when the player no longer attends to the narrative and is instead simply absorbed in the instrumentalities of gameplay.§尽管 Grant Tavinor 认为电子游戏因构成虚构的一个子类而属于艺术，Berys Gaut 也同样把它们归入电影的**领域**，但这两种路径都未能充分把握游玩这些游戏的一个核心方面：玩家不再关注叙事，而只是沉浸于游戏玩法的种种操作之中的时刻。§Posada: “My art is a journey through the invisible realm—a space where intuition, memories, visions, and dreams are free to take visual form.”§波萨达：「我的艺术是一场穿越无形**之境**的旅程——在那里，直觉、记忆、幻象与梦，都可以自由地获得视觉形态。」§§the realm of ... ……的领域§§改译文：漏译冒号后的部分（玩家不再关注叙事、只沉浸于玩法的时刻）

30873§testament§ˈtestəmənt§n. 证明；证据；遗嘱；（《圣经》的）约书§The show is therefore a testament to the Lindy Hop’s enduring influence on American culture.§因此，这场演出是林迪舞对美国文化持久影响力的**明证**。§§§§a testament to 对……的有力证明§§

30874§reign§reɪn§n. 统治；在位期间；朝代 v. 统治；称雄；盛行§Trade with other societies was vital to the Byzantine Empire, which reigned in the Mediterranean from around 330 CE to 1453 CE.§与其他社会的贸易对拜占庭帝国至关重要——公元约 330 年至 1453 年，它**称雄**地中海。§Though his reign ended roughly twenty years before Siam became known by its modern name of Thailand, King Chulalongkorn is often credited with ushering the nation into modernity.§尽管朱拉隆功国王的**统治**结束于暹罗改称泰国之前约二十年，人们仍常把引领这个国家迈入现代的功绩归于他。§§during his reign 在他统治期间§与 rein（缰绳）同音；作动词亦指「盛行、占主导」§

30875§outlook§ˈaʊtlʊk§n. 观点；看法；心态；前景；展望§In a large‑scale analysis, Lauren Hoult and colleagues determined that while different techniques produce varying outcomes, they all tend to have a more consistent effect on well‑being and positive outlook than on physical health and stress.§在一项大规模分析中，Lauren Hoult 及其同事确定：尽管不同技术产生的结果各异，但它们对幸福感和积极**心态**的影响，普遍比对身体健康和压力的影响更为一致。§The researchers used these ratings to rank the services for each group, with a conclusion that both stakeholders and general public regard the improvement of attitude and outlooks as important benefit of urban agriculture.§研究者用这些评分给各组的服务排序，结论是：利益相关方与普通公众都把「改善态度与**观念**」视为城市农业的重要收益。§§positive outlook 积极心态；the economic outlook 经济前景§§

30876§ethical§ˈeθɪkl§adj. 伦理的；道德的；合乎道德的§Purcell reveals that these works posit an ethical system in which an individual's actions are judged in light of how well they accord with the individual's role in society and how well they contribute to the community.§珀塞尔指出，这些作品提出了一套**伦理**体系：判断个人行为时，要看它与其社会角色的契合程度，以及它对共同体的贡献程度。§§§§ethics n. 伦理学；职业道德§与 moral 近义§

30877§matrix§ˈmeɪtrɪks§n. 基质；基底；矩阵；框架§Since chemically analyzing bulk samples can occlude contextual details, Slotznick et al. also employed high-resolution microscopy, which revealed volcanic debris—a known Mo host—around 2.5 Ga and microfractures in the surrounding matrix.§由于对大块样品做化学分析会遮蔽背景细节，Slotznick 等人还采用了高分辨率显微技术，结果显示约 25 亿年前存在火山碎屑（已知的钼来源），以及周围**基质**中的微裂隙。§The minerals in the rock sample record three growth stages: crystal core zones formed first, then rim zones, and finally the surrounding matrix.§岩石样本中的矿物记录了三个生长阶段：先形成晶体核部，继之是边缘带，最后是周围**基质**。§§the surrounding matrix 周围的基质；a matrix of options 选项矩阵§§改译文：bulk 没译出来（大块样品），「语境细节」改为「背景细节」

30878§merit§ˈmerɪt§n. 优点；价值；长处 v. 值得；应得§Forster and other prominent English-language novelists and found that there is a positive correlation between low -ly adverb frequency and novels’ perceived literary merit.§福斯特等知名英语小说家，并发现小说中 -ly 副词的使用频率越低，其被认为的文学**价值**越高，二者呈正相关。§Acclaimed author Sam Kean, who uses the form of nonfiction narrative to explore scientific discoveries, is interested in the collection less for its aesthetic merit than for its focus on “the false starts and mistakes that beset real scientific research every day.” Kean argues that all too often, scientists omit this “human stuff” from written accounts of their research and thus ultimately “fail to explain how science really gets done.”§以非虚构叙事探讨科学发现的知名作家 Sam Kean，看中这批藏品与其说因其美学**价值**，不如说因其聚焦「真实科研每天都遭遇的失败起点与失误」。Kean 认为，科学家在书面研究叙述中往往略去这些「人的成分」，因而终究「没能解释科学究竟是如何做成的」。§§literary merit 文学价值；merit attention 值得关注§§改例句2：starts 和 and 之间误加了句号

30879§vacuum§ˈvækjuːm§n. 真空；空白；真空状态；吸尘器§It represents the distance that light travels through a vacuum in one Earth year—approximately 5.88 trillion miles or 9.46 trillion kilometers.§它表示光在**真空**中一年所走的距离——约 5.88 万亿英里，即 9.46 万亿公里。§To investigate how market share affects consumers' likelihood of purchasing brand extensions, Alicia Grasby et al. identified 30 extended brand pairs (e.g., the same brand of vacuum cleaner and microwave) in household purchasing data; for each pair, Grasby et al. calculated the branded products' market share and calculated the increase in probability of a brand in one category being purchased if the same brand was purchased in the other category.§为考察市场份额如何影响消费者购买品牌延伸产品的可能性，Alicia Grasby 等人在家庭购买数据中识别出 30 个延伸品牌对（如同一品牌的**吸尘器**与微波炉）；对每一对，Grasby 等计算了品牌产品的市场份额，并计算「若在某品类购买了某品牌，在另一品类购买该品牌的概率增量」。§§a power vacuum 权力真空；vacuum cleaner 吸尘器§§

30880§consensus§kənˈsensəs§n. 共识；一致意见§Scientific consensus held that early dogs had large body mass and that a genetic driver of smaller size in some breeds (e.g., bulldogs) developed only within the last 20,000 years as a result of selective breeding for characteristics favored by humans.§科学界此前的**共识**是：早期犬类体型较大，而某些品种（如斗牛犬）体型变小的基因驱动因素，是近两万年内人类按偏好进行选择育种的结果。§If Venusian PH₃ does exist, it would indicate insufficiencies in the current consensus on Venus’s chemistry.§如果金星上的磷化氢确实存在，将表明当前关于金星化学的**共识**存在不足。§§scientific consensus 科学界的共识§与 consent（同意）不同，consensus 强调意见的汇聚而非许可§

30881§monetary§ˈmʌnɪtri§adj. 货币的；金融的§In a commodity money economy, specific goods act as a common unit of monetary exchange that can be used to buy and sell other goods.§在商品**货币**经济中，特定商品充当共同的货币交换单位，可用来买卖其他商品。§Champ and Freeman: when “individuals might come to accept one particular good in exchange for others even if they do not wish to consume that good…barter economies essentially become monetary economies.”§Champ 与 Freeman 指出：当「个人可能愿意接受某件特定物品来交换其他物品，即便自己并不想消费它……以物易物经济实际上就变成了**货币**经济」。§§monetary policy 货币政策；monetary exchange 货币交换§与 fiscal（财政的）区分§

30882§array§əˈreɪ§n. 一系列；大量；（整齐排列的）一组；阵列；数组 v. 排列；部署§In this work, Long set up a large circle made out of a balanced array of different‑sized pieces of slate.§在这件作品中，朗用**一组**均衡排布的、大小不一的石板围成一个大圆圈。§Farmer has shown that expanding the array of primary sources to encompass more types of print material‑including political cartoons, advertisements, and artwork‑leads to a much better understanding of the movement and the crucial and diverse roles that Black women played in shaping it.§Farmer 已证明：把一手来源的**范围**扩展到更多种类的印刷品——政治漫画、广告与美术作品——能让我们远为透彻地理解这场运动，以及黑人女性在塑造它时扮演的关键而多元的角色。§§an array of 一系列……§§改译文2：原译没译出 array（范围）

30883§hybrid§ˈhaɪbrɪd§adj. 混合的；杂交的 n. 杂交品种；混合物；混合动力车§As research continues, scientists hope to make advancements in hybrid systems combining multiple food preservation technologies, which would be advantageous over using microwave heating alone, given that it often heats food unevenly.§随着研究推进，科学家希望在结合多种食品保鲜技术的**混合**系统上取得进展——相比单用微波加热更有优势，因为后者常使食物受热不均。§He uses the term “flauna” to describe the plant-animal hybrids that he depicts in his surreal paintings.§他用「flauna」一词来称呼其超现实画作中的动植物**杂交体**。§§hybrid systems 混合系统；a hybrid car 混合动力车§§改例句2：句末多了一个句号

30884§generic§dʒəˈnerɪk§adj. 通用的；一般的；笼统的；无特色的§If "Frisbee" were judged to have become a generic term, as "aspirin" was, other companies would be free to use it to promote similar products, making it harder for Wham-O to stand out from competitors.§如果「Frisbee」被判定已成为像「aspirin」那样的**通用**名称，其他公司便可自由用它来推销同类产品，Wham-O 也就更难在竞争中凸显自己。§Participants in several of the experiments regarded the same products in the same (generic) retail settings as significantly more valuable when the product-to-space ratio was low than when it was high.§在数项实验中，参与者对处于同样（**普通**）零售环境中的相同产品，在产品与空间之比低时的估值显著高于该比值高时。§§a generic term 通用名称；a generic response 笼统的回应§§改译文2：generic 是「普通、无特色的」，原译「无品牌的」不对；product-to-space ratio 是产品与空间之比，原译「产品间距比」意思反了

30885§cognitive§ˈkɒɡnətɪv§adj. 认知的；认识的§Graham and Catherine Hobaiter hypothesized that humans may be able to interpret great ape gestures, either through an evolutionary inheritance or as part of more general human cognitive abilities.§格雷厄姆与凯瑟琳·霍拜特提出假设：人类或许能解读大型类人猿的手势，这或者源于演化上的继承，或者属于人类更一般的**认知**能力的一部分。§Though one prominent hypothesis posits that sophisticated cognitive adaptations are primarily driven by the demands of various behaviors within established social groups (e.g., cooperative response to predation), interactions with same-species outsiders arguably contribute comparably by favoring nuanced analysis (e.g., evaluation of relative physical status).§尽管一个著名假说认为复杂的**认知**适应主要由既有社会群体内各类行为的需求驱动（如协作应对捕食），与同种外来者的互动或许同样重要——它催生细腻的分析（如评估相对体格）。§cognition 认知；cognitive science 认知科学§cognitive abilities 认知能力§§

30886§closure§ˈkləʊʒə(r)§n. 关闭；闭合；停业；结束；（心理上的）了结§It appears that feeding triggers the closure of stomata—tiny openings that allow carbon dioxide to enter the leaf—thereby limiting plants’ ability to fix carbon (capture and convert it to carbohydrates during photosynthesis).§看来，进食会触发气孔**闭合**——气孔是让二氧化碳进入叶片的微小开口——从而限制植物固定碳（在光合作用中捕获并转化为碳水化合物）的能力。§The student, however, claims that ultimately audiences of the time preferred resolution and closure over ongoing tension.§然而该学生主张：当年的观众终究更偏爱化解与**收束**，而非持续紧绷。§§§§

30887§variable§ˈveəriəbl§n. 变量；可变因素 adj. 多变的；可变的；不稳定的§Lab studies are useful because they make it easy to control important variables, but white-throated sparrows' surroundings can significantly affect their hormone levels.§实验室研究之所以有用，是因为它们便于控制重要**变量**；但白喉带鹀的所处环境会显著影响其激素水平。§While there are several possible reasons for this, one is that practitioners may overlook confounding variables that account for the results they attribute to the interventions in question.§原因可能有好几种，其一是从业者可能忽略了能解释结果的混杂**变量**，却把结果归因于所考察的干预。§§control variables 控制变量；confounding variables 混杂变量；variable weather 多变的天气§§改例句：white-throated 的连字符误作破折号

30888§adjacent§əˈdʒeɪsnt§adj. 相邻的；邻近的；毗连的§Liao conducted tests to find where the difference in pressure is greatest between two adjacent sensors because, according to the researchers, as these pressure differences increase, so does the amount of information available to the fish.§廖氏做了测试，以找出两个**相邻**传感器之间压力差最大的位置，因为据研究者所言，压力差越大，鱼可获取的信息量就越大。§Curiously, the same barriers are associated with diversification within language families adjacent to isolates, such that the incidence of isolates like Natchez functions as an index of overall linguistic diversity in a region.§奇怪的是，同样的壁垒也与**毗邻**孤立语言的语系内部的分化相关，以至于 Natchez 这类孤立语的出现率可作为一地区整体语言多样性的指数。§§adjacent to 与……相邻§与 adjoining 近义§改译文2：原译「孤立语言毗邻语族」语序不通，改为「毗邻孤立语言的语系」

30889§entity§ˈentəti§n. 实体；存在物；（法律、商业上的）法人；机构§The Demak Sultanate, a Muslim sea power based on the island of Java that reached its height around 1500 CE, is considered a thalassocracy—a geopolitical entity whose hegemony resulted from control of the sea rather than of land.§德马克苏丹国是以爪哇岛为基地的穆斯林海上强权，约在公元 1500 年前后达到鼎盛，被视为一个「海上霸权」（thalassocracy）——一种凭控制海洋而非陆地取得霸权的地缘政治**实体**。§Bohr proposed that subatomic entities like electrons had only probable realities until they were observed.§玻尔提出：像电子这样的亚原子**实体**在被观测之前，只有概率性的实在。§§noncharitable entities 非慈善实体；a geopolitical entity 地缘政治实体§法律、商业语境常指「法人、机构」；与 being 相比更强调独立性与整体性§改例句2：句末多了一个句号

30890§pursuit§pəˈsjuːt§n. 追求；从事；爱好；消遣；追赶；追捕§But it's not clear that this is a worthwhile pursuit in any case—as Jin Ha Lee and Anh Thu Nguyen argue in their study of the South Korean band BTS, relationships between pieces of music may be best understood with concepts other than genre.§但无论如何，这是否是一项值得从事的**追求**，尚不清楚——正如 Jin Ha Lee 与 Anh Thu Nguyen 在对韩国组合 BTS 的研究中所主张的，音乐作品之间的关系或许用「类型」之外的概念来理解更为恰当。§This pose symbolizes their support for each other in the pursuit of equality.§这一姿势象征着她们在**追求**平等的路上彼此扶持。§§in pursuit of 追求；追捕……；a worthwhile pursuit 值得从事的事§§改例句：删去混入的「Text 2」标签和 Text 2 的句子

30891§journalism§ˈdʒɜːnəlɪzəm§n. 新闻业；新闻工作；新闻报道§Wells-Barnett’s accomplishment is just one example of the rich history of Black journalism in the United States.§韦尔斯-巴尼特的成就只是美国黑人**新闻业**丰厚历史中的一个例子。§Thus, it is unsurprising that this city became such a rich site for Spanish-language journalism.§因此毫不意外，这座城市成为西语**新闻业**如此丰饶的据点。§journalist 记者；journalistic 新闻业的§§§

30892§linear§ˈlɪniə(r)§adj. 线性的；直线的；（叙事等）按顺序推进的§Typically, synthetic leather is petroleum based, but materials scientists searching for an ecologically sustainable alternative have used various bacteria that secrete linear chains of glucose, forming a dense mesh of cellulose called a pellicle, which is leatherlike except in color.§合成革通常以石油为原料，但寻找生态可持续替代品的材料科学家已利用多种细菌分泌**线性**的葡萄糖链，形成被称为「菌膜」的致密纤维素网状结构，它除了颜色之外都与皮革相似。§Previous research has found evidence of Spanish speakers referring to the front/back axis to describe events in time, and many researchers believe that this tendency to make temporal distinctions along imagined linear axes is universal.§此前研究发现，西语使用者借助前/后轴来描述时间事件；许多研究者相信这种沿想象中的**线性**轴作时间区分的倾向是普世的。§§linear narrative 线性叙事§§改译文：漏译「除颜色外都与皮革相似」

30894§haven§ˈheɪvn§n. 避风港；安全的地方；避难所；天堂§Economist Gabriel Zucman finds that 8% of worldwide household wealth is held in tax havens (territories such as Singapore with low tax rates for investors who reside outside those territories).§经济学家 Gabriel Zucman 发现，全球家庭财富中有 8% 存放于**避税地**——即对非居民投资者征收低税率地区，如新加坡。§§§§tax havens 避税天堂（避税地）；safe haven 避风港§与 harbour 近义，但 haven 更强调「逃离危险或压力的安身之处」§删例句2：不含本词（haven’t 是 have not 的缩写）

30895§consciousness§ˈkɒnʃəsnəs§n. 意识；知觉；觉悟；（群体的）意识§The wood I walk in on this mild April day, with the young yellow-brown foliage of the beeches between me and the blue sky, the white anemones and the blue violets and the ground ivy at my feet, what grove of tropic palms, what strange ferns or splendid broad-petalled blossoms, could ever thrill such deep and delicate fibres within me as this home scene? My feelings seem to be those of our ancient earth in the daily ecstasy of its sun-kissed life; my own consciousness seems to stream through each blade of grass, each sucking root, to rise with the sap through the trees, to break out with joyous thrills in the waving fields of wheat, in the rustling palm leaves.§在这温和的四月天里，我漫步其中的这片树林——山毛榉嫩黄褐色的新叶隔在我与蓝天之间，白色的银莲花、蓝色的紫罗兰和地常春藤就在我脚边——哪一片热带棕榈林，哪一种奇异的蕨类或花瓣宽大的绚丽花朵，能像这片家乡景色一样，拨动我内心如此深沉而纤细的心弦？我的感受仿佛是我们古老的大地在被阳光亲吻的生命中日日感到的狂喜；我自己的**意识**仿佛流过每一片草叶、每一条吮吸的根须，随着树液在树木中升腾，在起伏的麦田里、在沙沙作响的棕榈叶间迸发出欢欣的震颤。§§§§class consciousness 阶级意识§§改例句：删去问号后的 7 个零宽空格；改译文：原译只译了最后一小句

30896§retreat§rɪˈtriːt§v. 撤退；退却；（冰川等）消退；退缩 n. 撤退；隐居处；静修之所§If instead the giant short-faced bear died out before humans could have altered its habitat, that suggests that its extinction was the result of some other factor, such as change in sea levels as a result of glaciers retreating.§如果巨型短面熊反而在人类能够改变其栖息地之前就已灭绝，那就表明它的灭绝是其他某种因素造成的，比如冰川**消退**导致的海平面变化。§§§§retreat from 从……撤退；a solitary retreat 独居的静修之所§§改译文：原译是另一段的（弗洛伦蒂诺神父弹簧风琴），按英文重译

30897§peer§pɪə(r)§n. 同龄人；同辈；同行；地位相当的人 v. 凝视；端详；仔细看§Carson published the first peer-reviewed rap album about his experiences with Black masculinity called "I used to love to dream." Typically in peer review, experts evaluate scholarly articles prior to publication.§卡森发布了首张经**同行**评审的说唱专辑，讲述他与黑人男性气质相关的经历，专辑名为《I used to love to dream.》。通常在同行评审中，专家会在学术文章发表前对其进行评估。§Economists have demonstrated that herding—in which individuals converge on the same action by imitating the economic decisions of one or more peers―occurs among investors.§经济学家已经证明：羊群效应——个体通过模仿一个或多个**同侪**的经济决策而趋同于同一行动——确实发生在投资者之中。§§peer review 同行评审；peer-reviewed adj. 经同行评审的；peer at 仔细看§§改例句：专辑名引号内多了空格；改译文：漏译专辑名和第二句

30898§inflation§ɪnˈfleɪʃn§n. 通货膨胀；通胀率；膨胀；充气§Mongolia, which, according to international indices, has relatively strong democratic institutions and low intranational income inequality, experienced an inflation rate of 4.30% in 2017, whereas Cameroon, which shows the opposite pattern on such indices, had an inflation rate of only 0.64% that year.§据国际指数显示，蒙古拥有相对稳健的民主制度，国内收入不平等程度较低，2017 年**通胀**率为 4.30%；而在这些指标上呈相反态势的喀麦隆，当年通胀率仅为 0.64%。§In 2017, Belgium, which has strong democratic institutions, experienced an inflation rate of 2.12%, much higher than the 0.74% rate seen in Equatorial Guinea, which has relatively weak democratic institutions.§2017 年，民主制度健全的比利时**通胀**率为 2.12%，远高于民主制度相对薄弱的赤道几内亚的 0.74%。§§inflation rate 通胀率；the inflation of a balloon 气球充气§§改译文：漏译「喀麦隆当年通胀率仅为 0.64%」

30900§inventory§ˈɪnvəntri§n. 存货；库存；清单；盘点§Comprising 7,200 simulated production planning instances, each involving seventy-two products across twelve time periods, the data set systematically varies three critical factors: product demand patterns (six scenarios, including fluctuating demand), production capacity utilization rates (high and low), and the balance between set-up and inventory holding costs (three scenarios).§该数据集包含 7,200 个模拟生产计划实例，每个实例涉及七十二种产品、十二个时间段，并系统地改变三个关键因素：产品需求模式（六种情景，包括需求波动）、产能利用率（高、低两档），以及生产准备成本与**库存**持有成本之间的平衡（三种情景）。§The algorithms help identify efficient production schedules by processing those quantifiable inputs (e.g., inventory levels and resource constraints) without exhaustively testing all possible scenarios.§这些算法通过处理可量化的输入（如**库存**水平与资源约束）来找出高效的生产排程，而无需穷举所有可能的方案。§§take inventory 盘点；inventory holding costs 库存持有成本§§改译文：漏译三个因素后面括号里的情景说明
